amendments.title: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) First Amendment Regulations, 2026
amendments.regulator: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)

changes.topic: Mandatory Bold Typography for % RDA of Total Sugars, Saturated Fat & Sodium
changes.summary: In sub-regulation (3) of regulation 5, the nutritional information for per serve percentage (%) contribution to RDA of Total Sugars, Saturated Fat, and Sodium shall be bolded and font size increased to ensure conspicuous prominence.
Exemption from per-serving RDA and servings-per-pack for specified foods for special dietary uses and infant nutrition products.
changes.note: Conventional granola is not eligible for infant-product exemptions.

changes.summary: Exemption from certain notified logo declarations for packages with total surface area less than 100 cm².
changes.condition: Total surface area < 100 cm². Dancing Fish 480g carton surface area exceeds 600 cm²; exemption does NOT apply.

changes.summary: Mandatory Front-of-Pack Indian Nutrition Rating (INR) star emblem (0.5 to 5 stars) for packaged foods with high sugar/fat/sodium thresholds.
